property_summary: After any call to updateRoundImplementation by the owner, roundImplementation equals the provided newRoundImplementation (reference) — the mutant sets it to msg.sender (owner) instead, so for inputs where the owner is not equal to the provided address the mutant will differ.
change_summary: Remove the require checking newRoundImplementation (allowing any address, including zero) and instead set roundImplementation to the caller (msg.sender), making the stored implementation depend on the caller, not the provided argument.
